# WILX

> WILX is a regional news platform delivering breaking news, weather alerts, and economic coverage with mobile app integration across iOS and Android.

WILX News serves as a local news source with comprehensive coverage of national and international events, including politics, economics, and disaster reporting. The platform emphasizes mobile accessibility through its dedicated iOS and Android applications with weather alerts and push notifications.

- [Drone explosion hits Russia's Black Sea Fleet HQ](https://www.wilx.com/2022/07/31/drone-explosion-hits-russias-black-sea-fleet-hq/): Ukraine drone attack on Russia's Black Sea Fleet headquarters in Crimea
- [70-year-old pulled out alive in Turkey as quake toll hits 75](https://www.wilx.com/2020/11/01/70-year-old-pulled-alive-as-turkey-quake-death-toll-hits-46/): Turkey-Greece earthquake disaster coverage with rescue operations update
